# Canonical Source Verification

All 110 unique canonical sources have current render provenance and were completely decoded with PyAV at 640 × 360, nominal 6 fps.

Every source retained its dimensions, nondecreasing presentation timestamps, declared frame count where present, and a complete end-of-video timeline. Every reused semantic source also retained a current measured narration trace bound to its source fingerprint.

Detailed SHA256, provenance digests, frame counts and durations are retained below; the temporary JSON was used to build this report before output cleanup. The retained `verify-sources.py` input reproduces this check. This establishes media/provenance integrity; independent sampled visual findings are recorded in `full-render-audit.md`.
